name: cdisc-core-validation
title: CDISC CORE validation with traceable findings
description: Validate SDTM, SEND, ADaM or USDM with the CDISC CORE rules engine and review every finding in one place. Runs standalone (upload datasets) or as a checkpoint inside a parent workflow (study package in the trigger). Published CORE rules run first, then local rules: a carried ADaMIG library (CORE publishes none) plus any sponsor rules. The report step builds core-report.html - findings grouped by rule and dataset, example records, what CORE could not check, the change since the previous validation, and, when a lineage.json is supplied, each ADaM finding traced to the program lines, spec entry and SDTM source that produced it. The reviewer records a disposition per finding (fix / justified / false positive); any 'fix' rejects the delivery.
preamble: CDISC terms (SDTM, SDTMIG, ADaM, ADaMIG, SEND, USDM, Define-XML, controlled terminology, CORE rule IDs, USUBJID) are technical workflow content.

triggerInput.name: package
triggerInput.description: Study package from a parent workflow: { study, profile, files: [{ name, downloadUrl, kind, sha256 }] }. Leave empty to upload datasets by hand.

triggerInput.name: version
triggerInput.description: Standard version in CORE's dash format (3-4 = SDTMIG 3.4, 1-3 = ADaMIG 1.3). Empty: the package profile's, else the newest the engine carries.

triggerInput.name: ct
triggerInput.description: Controlled terminology package, e.g. sdtmct-2025-09-26. Empty: the package profile's, else the define.xml's, else none.

triggerInput.name: onReject
triggerInput.description: On a 'fix' disposition: reupload = ask for corrected files in this run; return = end the run as rejected so the parent can regenerate them; auto = reupload standalone, return with a package.

steps.name: Resolve inputs
steps.description: Deterministic. Picks the files to validate from the study package (by kind) or routes to the upload step, and fixes the standard, version, CT package and reject behaviour.

steps.name: Upload datasets
steps.description: Upload one file per dataset, named after it (dm.xpt, ae.xpt, suppae.xpt, adsl.xpt): SAS V5 .xpt, .sas7bdat, Dataset-JSON or CSV. Optionally add one define.xml (Define-XML 2.0/2.1), a lineage.json and the programs it cites, sponsor CORE rules (.yml) or a core-policy.json. For USDM, upload the study-definition JSON.

steps.name: Run CDISC CORE
steps.description: Deterministic. Verifies each input's sha256, stages every dataset as SAS V5 (reporting, never truncating, what cannot be), then runs CORE v1.0.0 (issue rows capped at 1,000 per rule and dataset with -me; CORE's summary keeps the true counts): published rules, then local rules (carried ADaMIG library + sponsor rules). Always on CORE's pandas implementation (never Dask, whose findings differ), CORE's memory sized to the container, workers bounded by memory; a carried local rule with a published CORE id (CORE-000206, broken in v1.0.0) replaces that rule. Records CPUs, memory and seconds per pass. Writes core-report.json (merged), core-report.xlsx, core-report-local.xlsx and the staged datasets.

steps.name: Build the review report
steps.description: Deterministic. Writes core-report.html (findings by rule x dataset with example records, trace to code via lineage.json, downstream impact, rules not checked, change since the previous validation) and core-issue-index.json, and emits one review row per finding.

steps.name: Review findings
steps.description: Open core-report.html from the 'Build the review report' step. Give each finding a disposition: Fix required (default; rejects the delivery), Justified (explain why it stands - this goes to the reviewer's guide), or False positive (explain why CORE is wrong).

steps.name: Record the outcome
steps.description: Deterministic. Any 'fix' disposition rejects; otherwise accepted. Merges dispositions with earlier ones, publishes the reports and core-dispositions.json, and returns { outcome, files, package } to the parent workflow.
